limitations: Only newly issued receipts acquire absolute paths; legacy relative receipts retain original bytes and require independently established original context or remain HOLD. No guessed base or migration.

Absolute spelling and content hashes do not establish producer authenticity, filesystem immutability or a sandbox.
Fresh-process verification/consumption is not process-kill/power-loss/HA qualification.
Alternate-on compensates a read by controlled issuer cwd restoration; it does not satisfy new receipt persistence or grant authority.
Current request root, assignment, policy and lease checks remain independent; no portable current authority is inferred from a stored path.
